Affected PR #1227, exact merge `a1cf4cd86fd07d00ae592b4705e4b39f50628df7`, head `13466725f18398c8fd9642519b6711346ac1cfb3`. Original #1218 and predecessor #1152 are closed; preserve their successful fresh-name/metadata fixes and history, without reopening them.

Two independently reproduced defects in `data/regional-review/coastal-fresh-run-1160-erratum/fresh-reproduce.py` violate the original preservation and executed-code provenance acceptance:

1. Failure cleanup tracks created file identities but calls `target.rmdir()` without authenticating the directory identity. During the actual first product write, an audit-only fault writes and flushes a partial product, moves the command-owned directory to a private backup, creates a different empty directory at the same target path, and raises OSError. The unchanged actual entry point exits 2 and removes the replacement directory. Original device/inode was 16777231/184703748; replacement was 16777231/184703750. The command-owned partial product remains in its private backup (6,030 bytes, SHA-256 `f893a7507fa5179f39a16424ff1f3a4e1485b28e6899feb9c404ade4e0056f7f`). All paths belong to this isolated audit; no actual other worker data was touched. The demonstration proves a missing ownership guard, not production data loss. Cleanup must preserve any directory not created/owned by that invocation, even if empty.

2. The producer authenticates immutable Git bytes for historical `scripts/ellipsoidal_area.py`, but the verified historical geometry helper's `from ellipsoidal_area import area` actually loads the live checkout module through Python import machinery. This bypasses the Path.read_bytes input transport and its old-bank pin. An audit-only SourceFileLoader transport supplies the complete original helper plus a harmless unique marker (2,012 bytes, SHA-256 `598459e0487678dcd0caf7bf4cefaa9ace14fa948383b17fe5f5e09abcf06ae0`). The actual module contains the marker, the actual entry point exits 0, and all four products equal the retained baseline, while provenance still records the original pinned bank code. This is false provenance of executed code, not an allegation that the numerical baseline changed. Authenticate and execute the actual complete relevant project code closure, or reject its drift before execution/output; checking an unused copy is insufficient.

Reproduction: use an exact-merge managed sparse review slot and cached Python 3.12.14/Shapely 2.1.2/GEOS 3.13.1/pyproj 3.7.2 after complete disk/phase admission. Execute the unchanged main with output-only transport into exclusively audit-owned private vintages. For case 1 inject the precise partial-write/directory-replacement fault at actual `_write_exclusive`; leave publication/cleanup logic unchanged and retain both directory identities and complete partial output. For case 2 use a complete imported-module byte fixture at the exact actual source loader path, leaving project code files, pins, computation and checks unchanged; verify the marker in the actual loaded module and the completed result. Do not mutate or delete retained packets to construct controls. The reviewed audit adapter changes only input/output transport and explicit faults, not validation or numerical logic.

Eight actual executions completed: two fresh successful vintages, successful pair, traversal refusal, changed complete world-index input refusal, occupied-target refusal with unchanged sentinel, directory-replacement failure, and changed actual imported helper acceptance. Two fresh runs and the helper-drift run each match all four retained products byte for byte. All 59 materialized original files remained unchanged. Independently checked all 36 world members and three complete Census responses: all eight subjects, 296 source/Atlas identity fields and all 177 numerical values matched exactly using independently derived EPSG:6933 projection. Shared GEOS overlay is a method limit.

One additive erratum PR, exactly the original eight Georgia county IDs below, confined to the new owned directory. Earlier packets, all complete source bytes, identities/parents, dates, methods, vintages, metadata derivation and original outputs stay immutable. Read the original input bank and current producer as immutable evidence; provide the corrected producer/controls in this new directory. No shared-script repair, core hierarchy/catalog/geometry edits, boundary adjudication, import or publication.

Success criteria: record and check exclusive directory ownership across publication and failure cleanup, preserving replacement directories and all foreign/pre-existing entries; remove only this invocation's own unsuccessful products. Bind the complete actual consumed relevant project code and inputs before use, and include truthful executed-code/environment provenance. Two fresh actual CLI vintages and a genuine pair must reproduce independently checked baseline results. Actual complete-code mutation must fail before executing untrusted code or creating a passing output; actual partial-write/directory-replacement control must preserve the different replacement directory. Retain nonvacuous traversal, changed-input, stale-registry, duplicate/roster, occupied-target and scientific controls; preserve successful outputs and complete partial/failure evidence. Keep 32 MiB per-original and 256 MiB complete raw/decoded/code/fixture/output phase limits, not fragment-only accounting. Separate exact-head source and implementation reviews and required evidence gates must pass.

Limits: conditional 2026 AREAWATER units, memory-only invalid Census comparator repair, unresolved coast/water/island extent and geoBoundaries reuse terms remain explicit. No full-state roster, USA source-variant attribution, legal shoreline, geographic approval or production acceptance is established. The original fresh-name correction works; these are newly established ownership/provenance gaps.

Deduplication: complete all-state issue pagination had 14 pages (13 x 100 +79), 954 non-PR issues. Closed #1218/#1152 are previous bounded fixes. Open #1237 has 84 North Macedonia subjects; #1341 has two Saravan/Panjgur subjects; #1321 owns a 16-subject India/Pakistan seam; #1361 owns 15 Fiji subjects. Their code-provenance work is scoped to other immutable packets; extending active ownership would violate bounded scopes. No existing issue covers these eight coastal subjects and this producer. No later changes to the affected or proposed namespace through fresh main `43b48970e71af2b714d5355aeef9e31e3c99a23f`. Dependency #1218 is closed, budget one PR. Initially unready pending shared read-only scope/dependency/ownership review.
